acid.desc1: Acid is a surface that decreases Armour Class by 2 when stepped on.
acid.name: Acid

alcohol.desc1: Alcohol is a type of surface created by throwing or otherwise breaking an alcoholic beverage. It can be ignited or frozen.
alcohol.name: Alcohol

ash.desc1: Ash is a type of surface that appears after a Fire surface has burned out.
ash.desc2: Fine and formless dust. Whether treasure or trinket before is lost to the flames.
ash.name: Ash

black_puddle.desc1: Black Puddle is a type of surface. It inflicts  Despair to those standing on it.   Properties   Type: Surface
black_puddle.desc2: Fine and formless dust. Whether treasure or trinket before is lost to the flames.
black_puddle.name: Black Puddle

black_tentacles.desc1: Black Tentacles is a surface that significantly slows creatures passing through it.
black_tentacles.desc2: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill the area, turning it into  Difficult Terrain, and dealing 3~18⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage to all creatures entering it and  Smothering them.
black_tentacles.name: Black Tentacles

blade_barrier.desc1: Blade Barrier is an area created by Blade Barrier. It creates a damaging area of blades that deals damage to all who enter it.   Properties   Type: Summoned
blade_barrier.desc2: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill the area, turning it into  Difficult Terrain, and dealing 3~18⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage to all creatures entering it and  Smothering them.
blade_barrier.name: Blade Barrier

blood.desc1: Blood is a surface that is commonly created when living creatures receive damage.
blood.desc2: Douses unprotected flames. Can be frozen.
blood.name: Blood

caustic_brine.desc1: Caustic Brine is a type of surface created by throwing or breaking a Caustic Bulb. It also appears after destroying some environmental clutter found on Nautiloid such as Brine Bulb and Brain Jar.
caustic_brine.desc2: A pungent odour and acidic heat rise from this peculiar liquid. Deals 1d4⁠⁠Acid damage per turn.
caustic_brine.name: Caustic Brine

cloud_of_daggers.desc1: Cloud of Daggers is an area created by Cloud of Daggers. It creates a damaging area of blades that deals damage to all who enter it.
cloud_of_daggers.desc2: Spinning daggers fill the air. Anyone inside the whirlwind takes 4d4⁠⁠Slashing each turn.
cloud_of_daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers

cloudkill.desc1: Cloudkill is a cloud that deals significant poison damage every turn a creature remains within it.
cloudkill.desc2: Creatures who remain in the cloud take heavy poison damage. The cloud also heavily obscures what's in it.
cloudkill.name: Cloudkill

crawler_mucus.desc1: Crawler Mucus is a cloud that poisons and incapacitates those who are caught within.
crawler_mucus.name: Crawler Mucus

dancing_lights.desc1: Dancing Lights is an area created by  Dancing Lights. It creates an area of bright, magical light that illuminates the dark.
dancing_lights.name: Dancing Lights

darkness.desc1: Darkness is a cloud that prevents creatures from seeing into or out of the cloud.
darkness.desc2: A shroud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of the darkness.
darkness.name: Darkness

daylight.desc1: Daylight is an area created by  Daylight: Sphere. It creates an area of magical brightness, greatly illuminating the surrounding area and dispelling  Darkness.
daylight.desc2: A sphere of powerful light, bright as the sun.
daylight.name: Daylight

drow_poison_cloud.desc1: Drow Poison Cloud is a cloud that debuffs those that travel through it. When inside the cloud, characters must made a Constitution Saving Throw each turn or become Poisoned and fall Asleep. The cloud itself doesn't deal any damage.
drow_poison_cloud.name: Drow Poison Cloud

electrified_steam.desc1: Electrified Steam is a  type of cloud that applies  Wet and  Electrocuted to creatures residing within.
electrified_steam.name: Electrified Steam

electrified_water.desc1: Electrified Water is an area created when water becomes charged with lightning damage.
electrified_water.name: Electrified Water

fire.desc1: Fire is a type of surface. When stepped on, characters catch on fire and take Fire damage every round. Dipping weapons into this surface makes them deal an additional 1d4 Fire damage.
fire.name: Fire

fog.desc1: Fog is a cloud that blinds and obscures creatures such that they cannot attack into or out of the cloud.
fog.desc2: Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within.
fog.name: Fog

globe_of_invulnerability.desc1: Globe of Invulnerability is an area created by Globe of Invulnerability. It creates a dome where any creature inside is temporarily invulnerable to all damage.   Properties   Type: Summoned
globe_of_invulnerability.desc2: Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within.
globe_of_invulnerability.name: Globe of Invulnerability

grease.desc1: Grease is a surface. This flammable surface threatens to knock characters  Prone as they pass over.
grease.desc2: Difficult terrain - movement speed is halved and creatures may fall Prone. Flammable.
grease.name: Grease

haste_spores.desc1: Haste Spores is a cloud. Standing within these spores hastens a character for one turn.
haste_spores.desc2: Creatures have a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, their movement speed is doubled, and they can take one additional action per turn.
haste_spores.name: Haste Spores

hellfire.desc1: Hellfire is a type of surface. When stepped on, characters will catch on fire and take Fire damage every round that ignores any fire resistances. Unlike regular fire surfaces, Hellfire surfaces cannot be extinguished with Ice.
hellfire.desc2: Deals 6d6 Fire damage per turn that ignores Resistances and Immunities.
hellfire.name: Hellfire

holy_fire.desc1: Holy Fire is a surface that burns creatures with holy fire if they stand on it.
holy_fire.name: Holy Fire

hunger_of_hadar.desc1: Hunger of Hadar is an area created by  Hunger of Hadar. It creates an area of magical darkness that impedes movement and deals damage at the beginning and end of each turn.
hunger_of_hadar.desc2: A sphere of cold blackness, teeming with unknown horrors. Creatures starting their turn in the area take 2d6⁠⁠Cold damage. Creatures ending their turn in the area possibly take 2d6⁠⁠Acid damage. The area is Difficult Terrain and creatures within are  Blinded.
hunger_of_hadar.name: Hunger of Hadar

ice.desc1: Ice is an area. Created in numerous ways, it can knock  Prone anyone who travels over it.
ice.desc2: Difficult terrain - movement speed is halved and creatures may fall Prone.
ice.name: Ice

ice_cloud.desc1: Ice Cloud is a type of cloud that deals heavy Cold damage to creatures inside.
ice_cloud.name: Ice Cloud

insect_plague.desc1: Insect Plague is an area created by Insect Plague. It creates a damaging area of blades that deals damage to all who enter it.
insect_plague.desc2: Swarming, biting locusts fill the air. They deal 4d10⁠⁠Piercing per turn, make the area  Difficult Terrain, and impose  Disadvantage on Perception Checks.
insect_plague.name: Insect Plague

lava.desc1: Lava is an area. Characters passing through lava are slowed and receive massive fire damage per turn.
lava.name: Lava

malice.desc1: Malice is a cloud that pacifies creatures within, preventing them from taking actions.
malice.name: Malice

mind_flayer_blood.desc1: Mind Flayer Blood is a surface that is created when Mind Flayers receive damage.
mind_flayer_blood.desc2: The viscous, silvery ichor that flows through a mind flayer's veins.
mind_flayer_blood.name: Mind Flayer Blood

mind_sanctuary.desc1: Mind Sanctuary is an area created by the tadpole ability Mind Sanctuary. It creates an area that allows creatures inside to use their actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
mind_sanctuary.desc2: Anyone within the  Mind Sanctuary can take actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
mind_sanctuary.name: Mind Sanctuary

moonbeam.desc1: Moonbeam is an area created by Moonbeam. It creates a damaging area that deals radiant damage, and can be moved on every turn.   Properties   Type: Summoned
moonbeam.desc2: Anyone within the  Mind Sanctuary can take actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
moonbeam.name: Moonbeam

moonlight_butterflies.desc1: Moonlight Butterflies is an area created by  Moonlight Butterflies. It is a swarm of illusory butterflies that distract and enchant creatures inside.
moonlight_butterflies.desc2: An illusory swarm of moon-pale butterflies. Creatures inside the area are illuminated and all attacks against them have  Advantage. Creatures fleeing the illusion suffer 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage when leaving the area.
moonlight_butterflies.name: Moonlight Butterflies

mud.desc1: Mud is a surface that deals halves the movement of creatures passing through it.
mud.desc2: Difficult terrain - movement speed is halved.
mud.name: Mud

murderous_cloud_of_daggers.desc1: Murderous Cloud of Daggers is an area created by Murderous Cloud of Daggers. It creates a damaging area of blades that deals damage to all who enter it.
murderous_cloud_of_daggers.desc2: Spinning daggers fill the air. Anyone inside the whirlwind takes 6d4⁠⁠Piercing each turn.
murderous_cloud_of_daggers.name: Murderous Cloud of Daggers

mysterious_liquid.desc1: Mysterious Liquid is a surface created by breaking a  Nautiloid Tank.
mysterious_liquid.desc2: This vivid, briny fluid reacts to any heat that comes near it.
mysterious_liquid.name: Mysterious Liquid

noxious_fumes.desc1: Noxious Fumes is a cloud that inflicts poison damage on any character that enters or begins their turn within it.
noxious_fumes.desc2: Chance to affect creatures with  Noxious Fumes.
noxious_fumes.name: Noxious Fumes

oil.desc1: Oil is a type of surface. Oil surfaces have no effects while stepping on them, however will ignite and turn into a Fire surface when in contact with flame, such as from a Fireball spell or a lit Candle.
oil.name: Oil

pacifying_spores.desc1: Pacifying Spores is a cloud that pacifies creatures within, preventing them from taking actions.
pacifying_spores.desc2: Creatures submerged in the spores cannot take actions or reactions.
pacifying_spores.name: Pacifying Spores

plant_growth.desc1: Plant Growth is an area that significantly slows creatures passing through it.
plant_growth.desc2: Covered by weeds. Quarters movement speed.
plant_growth.name: Plant Growth

poison_cloud.desc1: Poison Cloud is a cloud that debuffs those that travel through it. When inside the cloud, characters must made a  Constitution saving throw each turn or become  Poisoned. The cloud itself doesn't deal any damage.
poison_cloud.name: Poison Cloud

potion_of_greater_healing.desc1: Potion of Greater Healing is a cloud that heals any creature caught within the area.
potion_of_greater_healing.name: Potion of Greater Healing

potion_of_healing.desc1: Potion of Healing is a cloud that heals any creature caught within the area.
potion_of_healing.name: Potion of Healing

potion_of_superior_healing.desc1: Potion of Superior Healing is a cloud that heals any creature caught within the area.
potion_of_superior_healing.name: Potion of Superior Healing

potion_of_supreme_healing.desc1: Potion of Supreme Healing is a cloud that heals any creature caught within the area.
potion_of_supreme_healing.name: Potion of Supreme Healing

purple_worm_poison.desc1: Purple Worm Poison is a surface that deals poison damage.
purple_worm_poison.name: Purple Worm Poison

raging_vortex.desc1: Raging Vortex is an area created by the Air Myrmidon's ability  Raging Vortex. It creates a vortex of buffeting winds that silences and damages everyone inside.
raging_vortex.desc2: Creatures that remain in the aura are  Silenced and take 2d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn.
raging_vortex.name: Raging Vortex

serpent_venom.desc1: Serpent Venom is a surface that potentially poisons those that travel through it.
serpent_venom.name: Serpent Venom

sewage.desc1: Sewage is a surface that halves movement speed and may cause you to slip. It can be found in abundance in the Lower City Sewers.
sewage.desc2: Difficult terrain - movement speed is halved and creatures may fall Prone. Flammable.
sewage.name: Sewage

shadow_cursed_vines.desc1: Shadow-Cursed Vines is an area of entangling vines suffused with necrotic energy. They are created by Shadow-Cursed Vine Blights, and are dropped automaticallly when blight creatures die.
shadow_cursed_vines.desc2: The vines deal 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage per turn, are  Difficult Terrain, and can  Entangle creatures.
shadow_cursed_vines.name: Shadow-Cursed Vines

silence.desc1: Silence is an area created by the spell Silence. It creates an area that silences everyone inside, preventing Thunder damage and spells that require a vocal component.
silence.desc2: Creatures that remain in the aura are  Silenced.
silence.name: Silence

simple_toxin.desc1: Simple Toxin is a surface that deals light poison damage.
simple_toxin.name: Simple Toxin

sleet_storm.desc1: Sleet Storm is an area created by  Sleet Storm. It creates a stormy area of rain and snow that impedes movement and disrupts anyone concentrating on a spell.
sleet_storm.desc2: A magical storm of snow, hail, and rain.
sleet_storm.name: Sleet Storm

smokepowder.desc1: Smokepowder is a type of surface created by throwing or breaking a Smokepowder Barrel.
smokepowder.name: Smokepowder

soul_ascension.desc1: Soul Ascension is an area created by Soul Ascension. It creates an area that significantly improves Raphael's cambions and damages non-cambions.   Properties   Type: Summoned
soul_ascension.name: Soul Ascension

spikes.desc1: Spikes is a surface that deals Piercing damage based on how far a creature moves through the spikes.
spikes.desc2: Deals 2d4⁠⁠Piercing damage every time a creature moves on top of the spikes.
spikes.name: Spikes

spreading_spores.desc1: Spreading Spores is an area created by  Spreading Spores. It creates an area of spores that deals Necrotic damage to any who inhale them.
spreading_spores.desc2: Beautiful as suspended snow, these spores sting your cheeks, set fire to your trachea, and putrefy your lungs.
spreading_spores.name: Spreading Spores

steam_cloud.desc1: Steam Cloud is a type of cloud that applies  Wet to creatures residing within.
steam_cloud.name: Steam Cloud

stinking_cloud.desc1: Stinking Cloud is a cloud that pacifies creatures within, preventing them from taking actions.
stinking_cloud.desc2: Creatures caught in this cloud might be prevented from taking actions due to its foul smell.
stinking_cloud.name: Stinking Cloud

strange_gas.desc1: Strange Gas is an area. It is a gas sublimate of githyanki pheromones. Exposure to this cloud requires passing a  Saving throw at the start of each turn within it, unless you are a githyanki.
strange_gas.desc2: A strange gas of githyanki origin.
strange_gas.name: Strange Gas

the_dead_wastes.desc1: The Dead Wastes is an area created by The Dead Wastes. It creates a damaging area that heals undead and damaging all others.   Properties   Type: Summoned
the_dead_wastes.desc2: A strange gas of githyanki origin.
the_dead_wastes.name: The Dead Wastes

the_wasting_quiet.desc1: The Wasting Quiet is an area created by the reaction Vengeful Playmate. It creates an area that silences everyone inside, and is dealt necrotic damage.
the_wasting_quiet.desc2: Any creatures within this miasma of childlike terror are  Silenced and take 3d8⁠⁠Necrotic every time they enter or start their turn inside.
the_wasting_quiet.name: The Wasting Quiet

timmask_spores.desc1: Timmask Spores is a cloud that briefly befuddles all who pass through. Can be created by approaching or destroying a Timmask.
timmask_spores.name: Timmask Spores

twisting_vines.desc1: Twisting Vines  is an area that entangles those who stand above it.
twisting_vines.desc2: Difficult terrain - movement speed is halved and creatures may become Entangled. Entangled creatures cannot move.
twisting_vines.name: Twisting Vines

unstable_blood.desc1: Unstable Blood is a surface created when a creature with the passive feature Unstable Blood is damaged and bleeds. Instead of  Blood, they will create an Unstable Blood surface.
unstable_blood.name: Unstable Blood

void.desc1: Void is a cloud that  blinds those that travel through it. While inside the cloud. Characters will also take ⁠⁠Cold damage at the end of each turn.
void.desc2: blinds creatures and deals 2d8⁠⁠Cold damage at the end of the turn.
void.name: Void

wall_of_fire.desc1: Wall of Fire is an area created by Wall of Fire. It creates a passable barrier that deals heavy Fire damage to all who enter.   Properties   Type: Summoned
wall_of_fire.desc2: blinds creatures and deals 2d8⁠⁠Cold damage at the end of the turn.
wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire

wall_of_ice.desc1: Wall of Ice is an area created by Wall of Ice. It creates an impassable barrier that deals heavy Ice damage to all who enter, as well as thsoe who remain after the wall is destroyed.
wall_of_ice.desc2: A pillar made of solid ice. When the ice is broken, it leaves behind a cloud of frigid air that deals 10d6⁠⁠Cold per turn to creatures within.
wall_of_ice.name: Wall of Ice

wall_of_thorns.desc1: Wall of Thorns is an area created by Wall of Thorns. It creates a passable barrier that deals heavy Piercing damage to all who enter.
wall_of_thorns.desc2: Giant, twisted thorns have sprouted from the ground.  They deal 7d8⁠⁠Piercing per turn, and quarter the movement speed of all creatures walking through it.
wall_of_thorns.name: Wall of Thorns

water.desc1: Water is a type of surface that can be created by numerous ways and manipulated by other elements.
water.desc2: Douses unprotected flames. Can be electrified or frozen.
water.name: Water

web.desc1: Web is a type of Surface. When stepped on, characters will move at half speed and they might become Enwebbed. Web surfaces can be created through the use of spells or grenades. In areas where spiders live, webbed surfaces may be present.
web.desc2: Difficult terrain - Movement Speed is halved. Can Enweb creatures. Prevents Falling damage. Flammable.
web.name: Web

whirlwind.desc1: Whirlwind is an area created by Sweetplum Gales. It creates a whirling tornado that can possibly restrain those inside it.
whirlwind.name: Whirlwind

wyvern_poison.desc1: Wyvern Poison is a surface that deals poison damage if the creature walking on it fails a Constitution Saving Throw.
wyvern_poison.name: Wyvern Poison
